title: FormalASR: End-to-End Spoken Chinese to Formal Text
abstract: arXiv:2605.19266v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems are typically optimized for verbatim transcription, which preserves disfluencies, filler words, and informal spoken structures that are often unsuitable for downstream writing-oriented applications. A common workaround is a two-stage ASR+LLM pipeline for post-editing, but this design increases latency and memory cost and is difficult to deploy on-device. We present FormalASR, two compact end-to-end models with 0.6B and 1.7B parameters that directly transcribe spoken Chinese into formal written text. To enable this setting, we build WenetSpeech-Formal and Speechio-Formal, two large-scale spoken-to-formal datasets constructed by LLM-based rewriting and quality filtering. We then fine-tune Qwen3-ASR at both model scales with supervised fine-tuning. translated_title: FormalASR：从中文口语到正式文本的端到端转换
translated_abstract: 自动语音识别（ASR）系统通常针对逐字转录进行优化，这会保留不流畅表达、填充词以及非正式的口语结构，而这些内容往往不适合面向写作的下游应用。一种常见的替代方案是采用“ASR+LLM”两阶段流水线进行后期编辑，但这种设计会增加延迟和内存开销，且难以在设备端部署。我们提出了FormalASR，这是两个紧凑的端到端模型（参数量分别为0.6B和1.7B），能够将中文口语直接转录为正式的书面文本。为实现这一目标，我们构建了WenetSpeech-Formal和Speechio-Formal两个大规模“口语转正式文本”数据集，其构建方式为基于LLM的改写和质量过滤。随后，我们在两个模型规模上对Qwen3-ASR进行有监督微调。在WenetSpeech-Formal和Speechio-Formal上的实验表明，FormalASR相比逐字转录基线实现了高达37.4%的相对字错误率（CER）降低，同时……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: FormalASR提出两个紧凑的端到端模型（0.6B与1.7B参数），可直接将中文口语转录为正式书面文本，省去ASR+LLM两阶段流水线，相比逐字转录基线实现高达37.4%的相对字错误率降低。
en_tdlr: FormalASR introduces two compact end-to-end models (0.6B and 1.7B parameters) that directly transcribe spoken Chinese into formal written text, eliminating the two-stage ASR+LLM pipeline and achieving up to 37.4% relative CER reduction over verbatim baselines.
